headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth in Q2 FY27, driven by AI‑related wins.
summary: Most listed firms reported double‑digit revenue growth, with TCS leading at 15.4% YoY and a 24% operating margin. HCLTech highlighted AI sales as a key driver, posting 11.5% YoY growth and a 78% jump in AI revenue. Wipro showed modest 9% revenue growth but a slight dip in profit. Several peers (Infosys, OFSS, Mphasis) have not released results, limiting full sector visibility.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑led deals and revenue streams are highlighted by TCS, HCLTech and Wipro, indicating early traction across the sector.

themes.title: Margin pressure at mid‑tier players
themes.detail: Companies like Persistent and Tech Mahindra posted lower margins or profit declines despite revenue growth.
